outcome: Placenta morphometric changes (area, number of knots, sprouts, CD163+ Hofbauer cells)
cohort: The study included placentas from 23 ZIKV-infected pregnant women, 24 HIV-infected pregnant women, and 22 healthy pregnant women as a control group.
finding: The study found that both ZIKV-infected and HIV-infected pregnant women had significant increases in placental morphometric parameters compared to healthy controls, with ZIKV-infected placentas showing more pronounced changes in sprouts and CD163+ Hofbauer cells than HIV-infected placentas.
